title: Agentic Workspace Evaluation Observation
description: One local-first append record for an owner-bound evaluation.

kind.description: Discriminator identifying one evaluation observation record.

recorded_at.description: Timestamp for when the observation was appended.

evaluation_id.description: Registered evaluation id this observation belongs to.

definition_revision.description: Definition revision observed when the record was appended.

criterion.description: Criterion id from the registered evaluation definition.

result.description: Observation result for the selected criterion.

real_session.description: Privacy-safe identity and workflow classification for one representative real session.

session_ref.description: Compact stable reference for the session; it must not contain prompt or transcript text.

workflow_classes.description: Declared representative workflow classes exercised by the session.

convergence.description: Matched before/adaptation/later evidence for a canonical source-owner change.

before_session_ref.description: Real-session reference where the original friction was observed.

later_session_ref.description: Distinct later real-session reference used to test convergence.

canonical_owner_ref.description: Existing canonical source owner changed by the adaptation.

adaptation_revision.description: Revision identity of the admitted canonical owner change.

equivalent_task_class.description: Matched task shape shared by the before and later sessions.

before_cost.description: Compact actual successful-completion cost observed before adaptation.

total_work_units.description: Comparable aggregate work units for the matched task.

after_cost.description: Compact actual successful-completion cost observed in the later equivalent session.

total_work_units.description: Comparable aggregate work units for the matched task.

human_steering_avoided_next_time.description: Whether the later equivalent task avoided the human correction previously required.

original_friction_recurred.description: Whether the original routed friction appeared again after adaptation.

context.description: Structured context facts for this observation; real-session evaluations retain compact references and metrics rather than raw transcripts.

evidence_refs.description: External evidence references; raw logs are not copied by default.

burden.description: Collection or review burden for this observation.

finding.description: Compact finding text derived from the observation.

recommended_action.description: Bounded next action recommended by the observer, when any.

idempotency_key.description: Stable duplicate-detection key for retry-safe observation append.

result_identity.description: Stable identity for the admitted decision-bearing evaluation result.

supersedes.description: Result identities superseded by this admitted observation.

admission.description: Admission decision binding the observation to current assignment, authority, baseline, and proof context.
